blurb: Halifax Harbor Marina offers permanent, seasonal, and overnight boat slip rentals with easy access to the Intracoastal Waterway and the open ocean. The marina is located near shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and local attractions such as Daytona International Speedway and Daytona International Airport. The marina enforces rules and regulations to maintain vessel appearance, safety, and environmental protection.
